description: This source file defines an abstract class 'Shape' within the MigraDoc library's DocumentObjectModel.Shapes namespace. The class provides common properties and methods for shape objects, including cloning, deep copying, formatting options (WrapFormat, LineFormat, FillFormat), positional properties (Top, Left), size (Height, Width), serialization, and internal value management.

classes.name: Shape
classes.description: Abstract base class representing a generic, positionable shape object in the document model, supporting properties for positioning, sizing, formatting, cloning, deep copying, and serialization.

classes.name: Shape.ShapeValues
classes.description: Nested class encapsulating the internal nullable property values of the Shape class.

methods.name: Shape.Clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the shape instance.

methods.name: Shape.DeepCopy
methods.description: Performs the internal deep copy operation of the shape, including cloning of formatting properties.

methods.name: Shape.Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the shape properties into a DDL format using the provided serializer.
